I’m sorry to hear the delivery is still delayed. Could you share the order number or the shipping address you used so I can look into it?
Sure, the order number is 112358 and the address is 742 Evergreen Terrace. I’m not expecting miracles, just a clearer picture.
Thanks for the details. I’ll check the tracking info on my end. Is there a particular date you were hoping to have it by?
Honestly, any estimate would help. I’ve already rearranged my schedule a few times, so I’m just hoping we can get a concrete update soon.
